sources.entry: Sequel Pro - MySQL database management for Mac OS X. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/sequelpro/sequelpro) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
Sequel Pro - MySQL/MariaDB database management for macOS.

summary.one_liner: Sequel Pro is a Mac desktop application for managing MySQL and MariaDB databases.
summary.what_it_does: Sequel Pro is described in its README as a fast, easy-to-use database management app for macOS that works with MySQL and MariaDB databases. The README itself is brief and covers only build steps, contribution guidance, and licensing, so it does not list specific features in detail. It points to a project website (sequelpro.com) for more details. Build instructions say to open the sequel-pro.xcodeproj file in Xcode and click Run. Contributors are directed to the issue tracker and a projects page for tasks.
use_cases: manage MySQL databases on a Mac
work with MariaDB databases on macOS
browse and edit database tables with a GUI
build the app from source in Xcode
contribute bug reports or pull requests to an open-source Mac app
how_to_run: Install the latest version of Xcode
Install GitHub for Mac (or SourceTree, or similar)
Click "Clone in Desktop" on the GitHub page
Click the Run button in the toolbar
If the above doesn't work, file a bug report
notable: Native Mac database client for MySQL and MariaDB
Project builds from source with Xcode
Community test builds and an issue tracker for feedback
caveats: Mac-only (macOS); the README describes it as a Mac application
Building from source requires the latest Xcode
README gives little detail on specific features
